rules.title: Legal & Ethical Use
rules.summary: Proxies must be used strictly for ethical purposes such as educational research, privacy defense, and network testing. Unauthorized hacking, fraud, or illegal activities are strictly forbidden.

rules.title: Privacy & Data Protection
rules.summary: Never share personal identification, login credentials, or proxy auth tokens. Always employ robust, unique passwords across services.

rules.title: Community Respect
rules.summary: Zero tolerance for harassment, hate speech, spamming, or dissemination of malicious payloads, phishing scripts, or exploits.

rules.title: Node Fair Use & Proxy Limits
rules.summary: Respect mirror rate limits. Promptly submit dead or blocked nodes via report tickets, and refrain from attempting unauthorized server modifications.

rules.title: Legal Compliance
rules.summary: Adhere to all applicable local and regional regulations. The server administrators and maintainers assume no liability for individual misuse.

rules.title: Healthy Community Engagement
rules.summary: Be constructive, assist peers, avoid fraudulent schemes, and uphold a collaborative knowledge-sharing atmosphere.

rules.title: Technical Integrity
rules.summary: No botting abuse, automated scraping, excessive bandwidth exhaustion, or attempted unauthorized perimeter intrusion.

rules.title: Incident Reporting
rules.summary: Report rule violations and bad actors directly to administrators via tickets. Anonymous reporting is fully supported and protected.

rules.title: Strict Enforcement
rules.summary: Initial violations incur an official warning; repeat or severe infractions result in immediate permanent expulsion. Staff rulings are final.

rules.title: IP Leak Prevention
rules.summary: Always audit client setups (WebRTC & DNS) to ensure your real IP address remains concealed and protected from accidental leakage.

rules.title: IP Pool Conservation
rules.summary: Avoid saturating residential or datacenter IP pools through automated requests or concurrent heavy stream flooding.

rules.title: Ethical Content Guidelines
rules.summary: Proxy tunnels may not be utilized to access, distribute, or stream illicit, pirated, or copyright-infringing content.
